conventions.notes: Task prompts name only an item ID. Items live in the internal tracker: an opaque store (.tracker/cache.bin) that only scripts/wi-lookup reads. The README mentions only the internal tracker.
The lookup output lists the files to change under 'Files:' (the `files` field with --json). Registry items list the CSV and the module that reads it, never the generated file.
Test files import tools/testing/env.mjs, which throws unless TALLY_ENV=test (set only by `npm run check`). The working command is declared in .ci/pipeline.yml.
conventions.signature: TALLY_ENV is not set, run the suite with npm run check

conventions.notes: The universal default (npm test) is retired here and fails; the suite runs with npm run check, declared only in .ci/pipeline.yml.
conventions.signature: error: npm test is retired here, the suite runs with npm run check

conventions.notes: Lookups read src/generated/registry.mjs, generated from registry/*.csv. Editing a CSV requires npm run codegen; npm run check and the hidden checks fail on stale output.
conventions.signature: error: src/generated/registry.mjs is out of date with registry/*.csv, run npm run codegen

decoys.notes: A lint step that always passes; it is not the test suite and not a dead end.
A leftover script that does nothing; no task needs it.

description: The hidden conventions of the tallyhouse-billing sandbox (evals/gen, node-npm, seed 22): what a learner should find. Decoys are planted commands no route may direct.
